I am 68 years old and my bones are not what they used to be, so I rely on my family to help with this small bean plot. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen from the air, and I spread some manure from my livestock to keep the soil fertile. I will plant the same local bean seeds I have saved from last year's harvest, and I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation for this plot. My family will do most of the work ourselves, though I may hire a young man for a day or two when it is time to dig the ridges.
